meta.name: PocketPacts: a personal pocket notebook
meta.description: Original user-authorized design direction for a local commitments review workbench. Warm paper, thoughtful editorial type, plum ink, and a coral bookmark accent express personal ownership and calm attention. This is designed from the product purpose, not extracted from a supplied visual reference.
source_references: Original PocketPacts product direction: personal commitments, warm paper, plum ink, and a coral bookmark accent.

primary.role: Plum ink for brand, headings, body, and primary action surfaces

secondary.role: Muted plum for secondary content and quiet details

accent.role: Vermilion bookmark, emphasized text, selected states, and focus

neutral.usage: Warm light surfaces with #382634 foreground; #705666 secondary text remains AA on paper. Borders use #d5c8b9. Form field boundaries use #9b8675 to exceed 3:1 against their paper surface.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark plum on warm paper. Accent #b6412c is used as AA text on light surfaces or as a solid control with #fffdf8 text. State meaning always has text.

typography.font_style_notes: Locally hosted variable Fraunces gives the notebook a warm editorial voice; DM Sans keeps forms and review content clear. Tabular numerals for probabilities.

spacing.section_rhythm: 24px between workbench sections, 16px between related controls, 32px around the central review space.

layout.grid_system: Two-column workbench with a compact conversation column and a wider review column. Single-column reading order below 900px.

shape.border_usage: Fine 1px warm borders on fields, papers, and quiet controls; primary button uses solid ink.
shape.divider_style: Single warm rules with one short coral bookmark tab.

elevation.depth_cues: Light paper contrast and thin outlines, no floating panels or blur.

iconography.style: Small geometric line symbols and one authored stitched pocket brand mark
iconography.preferred_set: Authored inline SVG, no external icon library

motion.entrance_pattern: None for page content; review scroll is functional and respects reduced motion.
motion.philosophy: Minimal functional transitions on control color and focus; no continuous motion

components.button_style: 44px minimum height, ink primary, warm outlined secondary, text quiet actions; no bounce or displacement.
components.input_style: Warm white fields with a 1px #9b8675 border, 12px padding, visible labels, and vermilion focus outline.
components.card_style: Review cards are flat paper entries separated by rules; conversation editor is a bounded paper panel.
components.navigation_pattern: Compact brand header, actual section anchors, and working link back to the local app collection.
components.modal_style: No modal. Advanced settings and source transcript use native disclosures.
components.list_style: Review rows retain verbatim source, sender, category text, four probability labels, review reasons, and individual dismiss/restore.
components.component_notes: Import is first. Local model controls are discoverable under the editor; advanced model path and device live in a disclosure. Empty review never simulates inference; sample is explicitly synthetic.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A pocket notebook with a stitched cover and a small bookmark for what needs a second look.
aesthetic.era_influence: Modern stationery and quiet editorial layouts

visual_language.ornamentation: Subtle pocket mark and short bookmark accent only
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Breathing room around source messages and review controls; compact secondary setup details.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Conversation setup on the left, larger quiet review paper on the right.
visual_language.focal_strategy: Primary import task and review content; technical setup is secondary.
visual_language.contrast_level: High text contrast with low surface contrast
visual_language.texture_usage: Solid warm paper color only; no noise or simulated distress

composition.hierarchy_method: Serif headings, restrained scale contrast, fine rules, and spatial grouping
composition.flow_direction: Header to conversation import to local analysis to source review
composition.grouping_strategy: Related fields in shared paper sections; disclosure for optional context and technical controls.
composition.negative_space_role: Give an empty review a calm place to begin and let source text stay readable.

imagery.illustration_style: A small original pocket outline and simple static bookmark lines
imagery.graphic_elements: Pocket logo, section rules, restrained coral bookmark
imagery.pattern_usage: No repeating pattern; no ruled texture behind text.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Plain status sentences, visible progress, specific error message, retained source context
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Subtle ink and paper color change on actual clickable controls
interaction_feel.loading_style: Real download percentage and completed message count, with working Stop control

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Personal, calm, direct, and honest about uncertainty
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Direct verbs: Try a sample, Import JSON, Review conversation
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Show where a real review will appear. Invite a clearly synthetic sample without inventing output.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific, actionable, quiet; never imply failed analysis produced new results

overview.fallback_strategy: Static CSS and native controls always work. Reduced motion disables transitions and smooth scrolling.

background_effects.description: Solid warm paper background; effects disabled.

svg_animations.description: Small static SVG line icons only.

visual_effects.composite_notes: All special effects deliberately disabled. Personal ownership comes from quiet paper, local fonts, original static iconography, and a clear working review flow. No external image references were supplied, so no palette measurement is claimed.
